content:
Analyzing the datasheet: ordering defines **FTLF8538P5BCL** (single-rate 25GbE) and **FTLF8538P5BCV** (dual 25GbE + 10GbE). Section V ties **10.3 Gb/s** and **25.78 Gb/s** to **FEC Free (1E-12)**, **Firecode (5E-8)**, and **RS FEC (5E-5)**. No **rx_sensitivity_dbm** appears in the excerpt, so those values are not assigned. **FTLF8538P5BCZ** / **FTLF8538P5BCz** are family placeholders (L/V suffixes); modes follow **BCL**/**BCV** evidence only.
